Job Description:

The opportunity

Hitachi Energy is a leader in high-voltage technology, offering a wide range of high-voltage products up to 1,200-kilovolt (kV) helping enhance the safety, reliability and efficiency of power networks while minimizing environmental impact. Our technology leadership continues to facilitate innovations in power transmission, enabling smart grids and enhancing eco-efficiency.

Hitachi Energy’s EconiQ™ high-voltage portfolio eliminates SF6 with reliable and scalable solutions for the lowest carbon footprint. The EconiQ line has achieved two world’s first – the replacement of SF6 in existing high-voltage equipment called EconiQ retrofill and the breakthrough SF6-free 420 kV circuit-breaker. Hitachi Energy has placed sustainability at the heart of its Purpose and is advancing a sustainable energy future for all. 

The ideal candidate must enjoy working in a dynamic, fast-paced business environment. He or she must be flexible to accommodate business requirements and experience in working with diverse groups and cultures. The ability to multitask & delivers within timelines is essential. The candidate will have excellent communications skills.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Executing & maintaining Lean Manufacturing,
  • Knowledge of Six Sigma, 5S, DMAIC etc.
  • Experience in Planning the work schedule & Managing the Shift & getting desired output by the team.
  • Assign duties to Employees, Trainees and oversee their progress.
  • Ensure that daily production goals are met.
  • Creating Production process reports.
  • Identify issues & efficiency and suggest improvements
  • Train and integrate new Operators.
  • Full understanding of industry Safety standards
  • Enforce strict safety guidelines and company standards.
  • Responsible to ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
  • Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business

Your background

  • Education: B.E/ B. Tech Electrical & Electronics
  • 3+ years of Experience in relevant field.
  • Diploma – Electrical & Electronics
  • 5+ years of Experience in relevant field.
  • Technical Qualification - Engineering Handling the Trainees & getting work done.
  • Understanding of industry Safety standards
  • GEMBA Board & Chart Shift wise Production Data, Safety Incident reports in Intelex
  • Daily management (Tier-1 & Tier-2)
  • Proficiency in both spoken & written English & Hindi language is required
